C. Cards composed from adapter hits plus the table (derived, never typed); a measure-next list per candidate; one command, deterministic, incremental, prints what changed; regressions enrolled; diff against a hand-made card in cards/

D. A short routed procedure (mode of an existing tool preferred) turning a module result into a Scientist assignment, a selection-file row or a hypothesis; one real result from C turned into one real row for the next batch

E. Run C on the three live axes (missense-class proteostasis, T-type calcium, downstream Wnt/MYC/GSK3/mTOR); report what the module found that the hand-made cards did not and what it missed; update README.md stage table and the reconciliation from measurement
E. Final report: self-evaluation per framework/protocols/session_self_evaluation.md, capability-scout entry, takeaways; land, gate, push

OPERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS: 2026-10-22, received through the Orchestrator during deliverable A, binding every deliverable and overriding anything in the mandate file that reads more rigidly: lean, flexible, modular; patterns easy to implement and easy to remove; NO rigid contracts. Concretely for B: the adapter 'contract' is a one-page convention (a small function signature, a dict in and a dict out, a self-test), not a schema with validation layers, abstract base classes, registries kept in sync, or version fields; an adapter is one file dropped in or deleted with nothing else to edit; the CLI discovers adapters from the directory and requires no registration; no plugin framework, no dependency injection, no configuration language; plain Python modules and files over any infrastructure. Before adding anything: would deleting it later be a one-file act? If not, simplify until it is. Each stage report says what was NOT built for this reason.
NOT_BUILT_BY_DESIGN: A: no survey schema, no candidate registry, no scoring of tools; one Markdown note plus one JSON list of calls, both deletable without any other edit

B: no abstract base class, no adapter registry file, no JSON schema or validator layer, no version field, no plugin framework, no dependency injection, no configuration language, no retry policy, no response cache, no ToolUniverse or OptimusKG install (direct key-less calls measured under a second each made a wrapper framework a dependency without evidence); the only shared code is a 30-line HTTP door; check_output() reports missing keys, it does not validate a schema
OPERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS_LICENCES: 2026-10-23, received through the Orchestrator during B, binding alongside lean/modular: licences of every external source read from the source's own terms page (URL and date), complied with (attribution, requested citation, share-alike, rate limits, user-agent/contact), unclear or restrictive terms are a block and the source is not used; ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md derived from the adapters' own fields and thanking the maintainers; every output names its source and retrieval date; no e-mail addresses in records.
